body: In an interview with CNA in The Hague, Taiwan's representative to the Netherlands, Tian Zhongguang, said Taiwan and the Netherlands already share a relationship of mutual trust in high-tech cooperation and are ideal drone partners in Europe. He said Taiwan's strengths in chip design and manufacturing, information transmission and precision machinery make it a highly trusted partner for the Netherlands, especially for drones involving a high degree of sensitivity.

Tian said the advantages of the partnership include Taiwan's work to build a non-red supply chain, its precision machinery, Dutch combat-proven experience in drone design and high-end system development. He added that the Netherlands has joined the World Alliance for Disaster Management initiated by Taiwan, so cooperation on water management can grow from bilateral to multilateral, and noted that the Netherlands is Taiwan's second-largest trading partner in the European Union.
en.summary: Taiwan's representative to the Netherlands, Tian Zhongguang, told CNA in an interview that Taiwan and the Netherlands, built on mutual trust in high-tech cooperation, are ideal drone partners in Europe, with Taiwan able to draw on Dutch combat-proven drone experience and the Netherlands having joined a disaster-management alliance initiated by Taiwan.
en.title: Taiwan's envoy to the Netherlands calls the two sides ideal drone partners in Europe

facts.claim: Taiwan's representative to the Netherlands, Tian Zhongguang, said Taiwan and the Netherlands are ideal drone partners in Europe, based on mutual trust in high-tech cooperation.
Tian said Taiwan's strengths include chip design and manufacturing, information transmission and precision machinery, and that Taiwan is working to build a non-red supply chain.

The Netherlands is hosting the European Union's drone and counter-drone technology centre, Dutch firms are jointly developing a fully indigenous integrated mobile counter-drone system, and the Netherlands has committed about 250 million euros with Ukraine to build a drone production line.
The Netherlands has joined the World Alliance for Disaster Management initiated by Taiwan, and the Netherlands is Taiwan's second-largest trading partner in the European Union.

body: 駐荷蘭代表田中光接受中央社專訪表示，台灣與荷蘭在高科技合作本就是互信關係，是發展無人機的最佳歐洲夥伴；台灣在晶片設計與製造、資訊傳遞及精密機械具優勢，尤其涉及高度機敏性的無人機，台灣會是荷蘭非常能合作的互信夥伴。
田中光指出，台荷無人機合作優勢包括台灣致力建立非紅供應鏈、精密機械的貢獻，以及荷蘭可提供的無人機設計實戰經驗與高階系統開發；荷蘭也已加入台灣倡議成立的世界災害管理聯盟，治水合作可從雙邊走向多邊。荷蘭是台灣在歐盟的第二大貿易夥伴。
zh.summary: 駐荷蘭代表田中光接受中央社專訪表示，台灣與荷蘭在高科技合作上具互信基礎，是發展無人機的最佳歐洲夥伴；台灣可取經荷蘭無人機實戰經驗，荷蘭也已加入台灣倡議的世界災害管理聯盟，雙邊合作可走向多邊。
zh.title: 駐荷代表：台荷互信合作，發展無人機最佳歐洲夥伴
